notes.annualCouponOverPrice: Annual coupon divided by market price

notes.durationWarning: Duration is a linear approximation. Convexity improves the estimate for larger rate changes.
notes.requiresMetadata: Requires bond or ETF duration metadata

portfolio.emptyMessage: Select a portfolio. Fixed-income analytics require bond metadata or ETF duration inputs.

cfa.description: Core fixed-income relationships used by the workstation.
cfa.inverse: Bond price and yield move inversely.
cfa.maturity: Longer maturity generally increases duration and rate sensitivity.
cfa.coupon: Lower coupon generally increases duration, all else equal.
cfa.convexity: Convexity improves duration estimates when rate changes are large.
cfa.dv01: DV01 measures the dollar price change for a one-basis-point yield move.
cfa.curve: Yield curves compare rates across maturities and may be normal, flat or inverted.
cfa.forward: Forward rates are implied future rates derived from spot rates, not forecasts.
cfa.reinvestment: Realized return depends on the rate available for reinvesting coupon cash flows.

quality.description: Sources, methodology and limitations remain visible throughout the analysis.
quality.optionsReuse: Risk-free rate inputs can be reused by Options Pricing Lab.

governance.description: Severity escalates with materiality, critical loss patterns and multiple high breaches.

governance.high: Material breach requiring risk manager attention.

methodology.title: Methodology & Assumptions
methodology.description: Limit Center uses deterministic rules and structured payloads before durable workflow persistence is added.
methodology.demoPersistence: Rules, breaches and review history use in-memory demo persistence in this version.
methodology.ruleset: Default rules are deterministic governance thresholds and can be extended from the Rules Library.
methodology.payload: Evaluations use supplied module payloads from Portfolio Builder, Risk Monitor, Volatility, Options, Rates, Stress Testing and Trade Simulator.
methodology.fallback: Athena Intelligence uses deterministic fallback commentary when an AI provider is unavailable.
methodology.missingData: Missing payload fields are returned as warnings instead of failing the evaluation.
methodology.notAdvice: Outputs are risk governance analytics and do not constitute investment advice.

errors.evaluateMessage: The source payload could not be evaluated. Check the API connection and payload shape.
